author: LFT
body:
After talking with a moderator for about 2 hours on these topics I have decided to tell the community about some suggestions I had and hopefully get some feedback / support.


Staff applications:

I believe that you guys should make the applications to the public. There fore meaning that, anyone can open and view the application and give their opinions. If you let more people see it than just the senior staff team the player can get more feedback on their application instead of the same copy and pasted message. I feel as with more people being able to see the application you could have a bigger staff team. A bigger variety. I have played avicus for 2 years almost 3 and every time staff applications open only two players out of maybe the 20 that apply get accepted. I believe that's due to the fact that their is very little staff that are able to give their opinions on a player or even just their application. EVEN IF you just opened it up to every staff member besides Media, Referee, Officials etc.. the player could have a better chance of getting accepted or have a better understanding of why he/she was denied.


Advertising (server, forums etc.):

Avicus needs people who can advertise their server and bring new people onto it. Even if you have to pay the person like 10 bucks that's fine. The server player count went from 300+ to 80-90 now. Also the "tip" that gives the link to the forums does not come up often. I feel if you made the tip come up more often the forums would be more active and more teams could be created.


Tournament prizes:

I am not saying to pay the winners but to give them a prize. Even if the tournament is only a good 15-20 teams at most give the tournament winners something special. Giving them the tournament winner rank is cool and all but I think their should be better prizes that attract more teams to participate in the tournament.


Screen sharing:

Now, I know you guys do this but from the moderator who I was talking with you do not know how to properly do it. For players who do not know what screen sharing is, it is basically where you make a player who is possibly cheating download join.me (A website where you can see their screen) and you make them go through their minecraft files and all that stuff until you either found the client or whatever or you didn't. According to the mod you guys only have a blank step process for screen sharing, I was not told the process but I already knew once I heard that you only have a blank step process that most players you do screen share get away with it unless they are really bad at hiding it. I have played Hardcore Factions (HCF) type servers like Kohi, HCTeams etc and they do screensharing, and they catch the most known kohi / hcteams players with ghost clients and injectable clients because they have such a long process. Screen shares should typically be at least 15+ minutes long unless the person your screen sharing is your friend and you know he/she cheats but won't ban him/her. The server I am staff on which is a HCF server is currently making a handbook about how to screen share. If the staff team would like I will give it to you guys when its done.


Limit's on how many ranks a staff member can be:

Avicus.net/staff shows that almost every staff member is also another rank. I believe that if you gave the staff member on only ONE that they can be out of what they have you would have more people wanting to apply for Moderator since some people might wanna stay Map Developer or Referee or Official instead of being a mod. (Personally don't really like this suggestion but I brought it up to the staff member and decided why not bring it up here)


Add /broadcast for Donors:

Hear me out, Kohi has this and it actually works. If you give donators permissions to /broadcast the server they are on and want people to come play like Kohi's more players will go and play a CTW or a walls match or even Nexus. Everyone sits on DTM and on throwback but their is other game types the server has and people don't play it.

Example: https://gyazo.com/7107cc7d8b2f771d9d70db23f2c867b0


Add a new game type or bring back Skywars or SG:

The name of the suggestion says it all, I mean the server needs to reach out to a different variety of players instead of only DTM, CTW or just iron pvp. We need like pot pvp or just something to spice things up and get more people on the server.

Check the staff page consistently:

This also goes for Media and Referee's even though I don't consider them staff. I was checking the 'staff' page recently and saw that there were players that haven't played in a week+ that are still staff or even 2 months. I feel that you guys should check this consistently (maybe once a week?) and unless they told you why they wouldn't be online (through slack or skype) then they should be demoted or atleast given some sort of warning depending on how little / long it was.


Add permanent scrimmage servers for teams:

What about adding private scrimmage servers and having a requirement. Sort of like you have requirements for a private teamspeak channel you can have requirements for teams to get their OWN personal server that does NOT get removed or allow someone to reserve it unless you fall behind the requirements. Similar to what OCN has for tournaments but why not bring it here and make it a thing. I personally hate waiting for a reservation but that's just me maybe?


I worded this poorly sorry, currently in class.

Could have probably made this post longer but I am at school and didn't want to get in trouble for the misuse of my school laptop.

replies.body:
In my opinion, I don't agree with your suggestion on topic of Staff Applications. Firstly, if applicants' applications are shared publicly, their responses would be 'stolen' and used for others' own benefits. Secondly, their private information like their email addresses would be shared publicly, which some people might not like that to happen. People should make their own applications and not based theirs off others'.

About your suggestion on a limit on how many ranks a staff member can have, I don't get why staff members shouldn't have more than two ranks. If they can handle two responsibilites, and they can do a good job at it, why not let them have two ranks?

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Ok, well I'm going to give my opinion of these ideas from a community view point, since I haven't been staff long enough anyways.

Staff apps
There's honestly no benefit of this. I can see it leading to issues where the players/community disagrees with the staff for giving a player a staff rank, because they personally feel like he/she should not. At the end of the day, Sr staff pick the staff (or map devs for map devs, and officials for refs and media). If you want feedback, you can ask someone. Anyone. Go to a Skype group chat you're in and post it there.

Tournament prizes
First, we'd need a good anti-cheat to make sure who ever wins actually deserves the prize. 

Limit's on how many ranks a staff member can be
I honestly can't see a benefit in this. Yes I agree, it could open up more slots for new people, but what if a staff member could do a better job? Then should he not be able to do that second staff position? 
Also, if something like ref apps open, everyone applies, even the other staff. I have no idea what the app selection is like, but I assume they take everyone in account, not just the people with other ranks.

In terms of all the others I agree (expect Screen Sharing, I really have no opinion on that, so long as the system works). My only other concern is with Broadcasting. It could turn out to be spammy, or end up being a "norm" and ignored.

replies.author: FrozenSolstice
replies.body:
There are a few problems here.

First, we have the obvious threat of others copying applications. We want to know how fluent someone is at writing English, how well developed their spelling/grammar skills are. It doesn't help when we have a player copy another application, and tweak it slightly to make it look like their own.

My second and final point is that we're going to have trolls. People may give proper feedback, others will troll the application. Not to mention that we've had people give away names and etc in the past, and that shouldn't be made open to the general public.

My two cents.

replies.author: Midnightstorm
replies.body:
Personally, I disagree with your staff application suggestion.
As stated previously, other members of the community could possibly copy people's staff applications. Most of the time, if not always, there is a small bit of personal information that goes into staff applications that some would rather not have open to a public audience. Although your point on fellow members reviewing an application is a good one, that also comes along with the possibility of someone trolling or lying about how someone acts.

I agree with your point on advertising.
Along with tournament prizes, it would be very beneficial to the community and the player count of the server.

I also agree with your screen-sharing point.
A set of instructions or a guide would be nice, since some staff members (like myself), have not gone through the process of how to conduct a proper screen-share.

I disagree with your point on limited ranks for a staff member.
A person should be able to have freedom in what they do. With proper responsibility and time management, handling multiple ranks should not be a problem.

I am not so sure with the broadcast for donors.
This action could be easily abused, unless a specific menu selection was added in with preset messages.

I DEFINITELY agree with your last point on adding in a new game-mode like Skywars.
I would love to see some new games on the server, and I'm sure others would love that as well. Additionally, this can increase player counts and interest in the server.
I've even heard a rumor about some new game-modes. ;)

replies.author: _Nathy
replies.body:
Staff apps:

Giving the public more say is good, but as mentioned people will almost certainly vote for their friends, be bias and then this gets really out of control. Finding a way where some members of the community wouldn't be able to abuse this system would be bloody difficult and we might suffer casualties along the way.

Advertising:

Yes please, we need this. I don't know if many of you know a server called Island Clash, but it was a new server made a few months ago. The owner threw some money at Preston and Woofless and now they almost always have at least 120 players on at a time during Aussie times and about 600-700 players on at U.S times. We have such an awesome community here that want to see Avicus thrive and I'm sure that if money was needed to fund this, that some of us would chip in to help.

Tourney Prizes:

There should definitely be a tourney prize, but it has to be a "prize". I like the forum rank, but as for anything else, I don't think that anyone really cares that much about credits. A cash prize would be great, but we need a larger player base before that can happen to keep the server's budget sustainable.

Screensharing:

TBH the current method is laughable. It rarely happens, but if the person you are screensharing has an IQ over 10, they can hide a ghost client from our current screensharing instructions. This needs a lot of work! I didn't know what a screenshare was before I was trained on teamspeak but once I learnt what it was, I was disappointed when we were shown how to do it. Following the instructions we were given I could hide my 30 hack in one trolling client and pass a screenshare and probably only a few staff members would be able to find it.

Staff rank limits:

I think that if someone can handle multiple ranks, then they should be allowed to have them. Using me as an example, if I was a mapdev, mod, dev and official, there would be no way in hell that I'd be able to get through my school studies and at the same time be able to contribute actively to all those roles. Some people have more time than me and so they would have enough spare time to attend to all of those roles. So this really depends on the person, If they can dedicate enough time to all their positions and do them well, then I don't see a reason as to why we shouldn't allow them to actively contribute to the server.

Donor broadcasting: 

I like this idea, but it could be spammed. If the server was bombarded with 20 donator broadcasts at once that gets ugly. But I do like the idea that donators could alert other players of another game happening on another server. +1 to this idea.

Add a new gamemode:

Avicus basically has nebula and the occasional walls game or CTH. There was massive hype when avicade came out, but that died fairly quickly and I think the only person that still practices an avicade gamemode is Pokerface with his addiction to snake. I think we need to bring a new gamemode out, add our own avicus twist to it to make it unique and to advertise it. This could be a great way to attract new players.
